description: Dabrafenib with trametinib is recommended, within its marketing authorisation, as an option for the adjuvant treatment of resected stage 3 BRAF V600 mutation-positive melanoma in adults. It is recommended only if the company provides dabrafenib and trametinib with the discounts agreed in the commercial arrangements.
